scope: Exact named terminal self exclusions only, no directory/glob exclusions

files.SHA256-MANIFEST.json: manifest cannot include its own content hash without circularity
files.terminal_manifest.receipt.json: this receipt is emitted by immutable runner only after this terminal script completes; not yet completed at snapshot
files.terminal_manifest.output.txt: this output is emitted alongside terminal receipt after script completes; not yet present at snapshot

completed_receipts: All runner receipts completed at manifest snapshot plus preserved bootstrap-receipt.json are hashed; last terminal receipt intentionally outside its own snapshot.
